page.overview:
Who is Omnivincible?

Nolan Grayson (father) Debbie Grayson (mother)

Main Atom Eve (attempted victim) ReAnimen Cecil Stedman (indirectly) Global Defense Agency (indirectly) Angstrom Levy (former ally) Alternate Atom Eve

Omnivincible is a supporting antagonist in the third season of the series. He is an evil variant of main Invincible from another universe.

Omnivincible was assembled by Angstrom Levy to help start the Invincible War in the mainstream dimension. After the war, he and the surviving variants turned on Angstrom for breaking their deal and were subsequently banished to the Wasteland Universe.
